title: Wellbore management
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: the list is only the selected well's bores, a wellbore cannot exist without its well, deleting a bore with linked surveys is refused with the count, a total depth carries its unit (and disables survey screens without one), and a sidetrack records its parent

dataModel.decision: The codebase had no WELLBORE entity (no class, no PPDM metadata entry, no well/BAL column), so the owner table was added with the user's approval.
dataModel.tables: Beep.OilandGas.LifeCycle/Data/Tables/WELLBORE.cs and WELLBORE_SURVEY.cs, registered in Modules/LifeCycleModule.cs so module setup creates them
dataModel.keys: WELLBORE (UWI, WELLBORE_ID); WELLBORE_SURVEY (UWI, WELLBORE_ID, SURVEY_ID, SOURCE)
dataModel.verified: LIFECYCLE module setup applied and the SQLite database contains both tables with those keys (plus the common columns the module adds)

implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellboresPageView.cs (route 'wellbores': grid, parent/child tree, detail, depth-unit chip, create, delete)
implementation.navigation: WellHeaderPageView has a Wellbores action; the page opens the well in the shared context
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/WellboreTests.cs (8, no database) + WellboreGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.ac1_filter: UWI-A listed 2 (then 3) bores and UWI-B 1; every row carried its own well
integration.ac2_parent: creating under UWI-MISSING refused with wellbore-parent-well-missing
integration.ac3_surveys: deleting WB-1 with one linked survey refused with wellbore-has-surveys and '1 survey(s) linked'
integration.ac4_depth: WB-1 showed '3000 m' with SurveyEnabled true; WB-2 (no unit) showed '(unit unspecified)' and SurveyEnabled false
integration.ac5_sidetrack: SIDETRACK without a parent refused with wellbore-parent-required; unknown parent refused with wellbore-parent-unknown; with parent WB-1 created and listed with ParentId WB-1
integration.other_rules: duplicate refused, a bore with a child refused, the last bore of a well refused, a leaf without surveys deleted

gates.AC-1 The list only contains wellbores of: pass - ListAsync filters WELLBORE by UWI in SQL; the SQLite test seeds two wells and asserts each list contains only its own bores.
gates.AC-2 A wellbore cannot exist without a p: pass - CreateAsync refuses when the well row does not exist (wellbore-parent-well-missing); the table key includes UWI, so a row cannot be stored without one.
gates.AC-3 Deleting a wellbore with surveys is: pass - the delete counts WELLBORE_SURVEY rows for the bore; with one link it refused with wellbore-has-surveys and the sentence 'has 1 survey(s) linked'. Removing the link and the child lets the delete succeed.
gates.AC-4 Total depth carries a unit: pass - TOTAL_DEPTH and TOTAL_DEPTH_OUOM are stored together; the summary exposes DepthText ('3000 m') and SurveyEnabled false with 'unit unspecified' when the unit is missing.
gates.AC-5 A sidetrack records its parent expl: pass - SIDETRACK/REDRILL without a parent is refused; a parent must exist on the same well; a sidetrack created with parent WB-1 is listed with ParentId WB-1 and appears under it in the tree.

limits: WELLBORE and WELLBORE_SURVEY are a new LifeCycle-owned model (approved), not PPDM 3.9 tables; an existing database needs the LIFECYCLE module applied again to gain them.
Nothing populates WELLBORE_SURVEY yet - the survey pages (VSB-07, ENG-01) will - so today AC-3 blocks a delete only when a link has been created.
The page creates and deletes; it does not edit an existing bore's name/depth/parent (the plan's list is met, but editing is a later step).
Spud date and surface coordinates are accepted by the service but have no editor on the page yet.
Depth unit is free text (m/ft/...), not a reference list.
The page is exercised by construction and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives the grid or tree.
